description: This file defines an API client module for interacting with backend endpoints, including functions for health checks, listing users, sessions, deployments, and LLM costs, as well as internal helper functions for URL building, query parameter handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining a base URL with a relative path or returning absolute URLs as-is.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Builds a query string from an object of parameters, handling arrays and nested objects.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot
methods.description: Checks if a URL path is the root of session tracking collection.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on endpoint-specific rules.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams
methods.description: Ensures query parameters include necessary scope identifiers like organization_id or tenant_id.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Merges additional parameters into a URL, handling existing query strings.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses fetch response, returning JSON or text payload with status info.

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request with URL building, parameter scoping, and response parsing.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON body, handling response parsing and errors.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes list responses to include items, total count, and meta information.
